reviewer: Independent protocol reviewer, separate from the campaign implementer
scope: Permission gate for the frozen, user-authorized USD 10 campaign only. This does not approve an effectiveness claim or a manuscript/publication update.

checks.source_code_review: Reviewed the new client, editor gateway and campaign runner, plus inherited finalization, scoring and candidate sandbox code.
checks.schedule: 64 unique episode IDs; eight lineages; four replicates per lineage/arm; all 32 blocks contain both arms of the same task/replicate.
checks.budget: Separate USD 10 ledger, shared-client thread lock, atomic pre-network reservations, unknown-cost retention, finite nonnegative cost validation, pinned provider/price ceilings, no-tools final detection, and reservation for remaining final reports.
checks.budget_boundary_tests: Insufficient budget prevents transport; process interruption retains reservation; retry errors are retained and secrets redacted; nonfinite cost cannot corrupt budget comparisons; provider mismatch/excess charge stops the request.
checks.information_equality: Non-editor tool schemas are equal. Both arms expose the same normalized source-version hash and line-numbered source. Only the editing interface differs.
checks.editor_semantics: Checked exact-match rejection, stale-version rejection, path authorization, inclusive span bounds, overlap rejection, same-original-version multi-span addressing, syntax validation, and all-or-nothing multi-file validation.
checks.primary_metric: Actual normalized source-text change, complete frozen semantics, authorized paths, and independent source-policy review. Byte-only newline changes or optional-test-only changes are not sufficient.
checks.completion: Budget/infrastructure interruption is retained separately and prevents an effectiveness conclusion. Non-transient engineering errors stop new blocks. Full replay and independent review are explicitly pending after ordinary execution.
checks.scientific_assets: Verified task metadata, data plan, local bundle manifest and oracle hashes; verified recorded remote snapshot hash and fixed ARM64 Docker identity.
checks.preflight_execution_status: All sixteen recorded Docker executions returned exit code zero and their scores were reproduced from observations with the frozen judge.

prior_review_resolution.M1: Resolved by isolated durable accounting and offline budget tests, including the added nonfinite-cost test.
prior_review_resolution.M2: Resolved for starting the bounded campaign by explicit completion gates, normalized source-change reporting and pending source-policy review. Automatic resumption is deliberately not implemented; partial runs must remain incomplete until separately audited engineering recovery.
prior_review_resolution.M3: Resolved by equal non-editor information and explicitly attributing any effect to the entire version-checked line-span interface, not line numbers alone.
prior_review_resolution.M4: Resolved by bound script/test/data-plan hashes, checked local/remote assets, non-overwriting preflight and required final replay.

limits: Execute one campaign process only. Two workers may share its single client/ledger; this is not a multi-process budget service.
Eight known public lineages are a small, dependent resource sample. Report each lineage and avoid treating 64 attempts or semantic observations as independent defects.
Replicate IDs are not evidence of matched model randomness. The schedule blocks and interleaves deployment conditions but does not establish a verified model-weight revision.
The intervention includes the editing schema, version checking and line addressing. A result cannot isolate any one component.
The existing 120000-byte exploration guard is unchanged; request bytes are not token counts or a model context-capacity measure.
Any interrupted attempt requires separate engineering recovery review before resumption; never restart to select a better semantic outcome.
No efficacy conclusion before all planned outcomes and full replay are complete. No update to the submitted paper until independent outcome/source-policy review and the user's subsequent decision.
